## What we sell
1. Magnetic separators — grate, bullet, drawer, pulley, plate; typical rare-earth gauss 10,000–13,000; food-grade options
2. NdFeB (neodymium) rare-earth magnets — grades N35–N52; custom sizes and coatings
3. Lifting magnets — permanent and electro; safety factor about 3:1; capacities sized to load

## Who we sell to
Factories and plants in food processing, plastics, recycling, chemicals, bulk materials, construction/steel handling, OEMs and MRO across Malaysia. ASEAN inquiries welcome. Based in Shah Alam; supply Malaysia-wide.

## What we are not
- Not a consumer fridge-magnet gift shop
- Not an online cart with published RM list prices (B2B written quotes via WhatsApp)
- Not based in Kuala Lumpur — address locality is Shah Alam, Selangor

## Pricing
No public RM prices. Buyers WhatsApp +60 19-662 6522 for a written quote with duty, size and quantity.
